description: OpenSSL PACKAGECONFIG flags that affect CVE applicability

no-ssl3.notes: Disables SSLv3 protocol entirely at compile time. POODLE and related attacks not applicable.

no-ssl2.notes: Disables SSLv2 protocol. DROWN attack not applicable. Already removed in OpenSSL 1.1.0+.

no-tls1.notes: Disables TLS 1.0. BEAST and Lucky13 on TLS 1.0 not applicable. Some CVEs may also affect TLS 1.1/1.2.

no-tls1_1.notes: Disables TLS 1.1. Few CVEs are TLS 1.1-specific; most affect the broader TLS stack.

no-weak-ssl-ciphers.notes: Removes DES, 3DES, RC4, export ciphers. SWEET32 and Logjam not applicable when weak ciphers removed.

no-deprecated.notes: Removes deprecated API functions. May suppress CVEs in deprecated codepaths but coverage varies by version.

no-comp.notes: Disables TLS compression. CRIME attack not applicable.

no-idea.notes: Removes IDEA cipher. Specific IDEA-related vulnerabilities not applicable.

no-md2.notes: Removes MD2 hash. Already not compiled by default in modern OpenSSL.

no-hw.notes: Disables hardware crypto engine support. May suppress engine-specific CVEs but rarely relevant.
